scope: Tests only: episode, scene and shot creation receipts; no product, migration, runtime or service changes.
observedBehavior: Each public create route returns 201 once and an identical cached object for the same body, original If-Match and original Idempotency-Key while its receipt remains valid.

After only that isolated fixture receipt is expired, the unchanged original request returns 412 VERSION_CONFLICT. Public content reads retain the exact object count, IDs, content revision and shot specification.

After project membership is removed through the public API, each route rejects its still-valid cached request with 404 NOT_FOUND. The same session and tenant membership remain usable; no cached entity ID is returned and the owner reads unchanged content.
isolation: Existing businessFixture uses a random PostgreSQL schema with restricted API/auth roles and removes its own schema/roles at teardown. Only that fixture receipt deadline is advanced for expiry; continuous runtime data is untouched.
limitations: This proves duplicate prevention after receipt expiry, not automatic recovery of an expired receipt or the created object ID.
Frontend IndexedDB/refresh behavior and complete CI are handled by the parent integration.
review: Reviewed the added test; git diff --cached --check passed. Existing behavior passed without any product change.
